title: Usage Metering and Invoicing
hints: Usage pipelines deliver at least once. Drop every event whose id you've already seen before doing anything else.
Split the period into one segment per plan. A segment covers [change day, next change day), so an event on the change day belongs to the new plan.
Prorate the base fee and the included quota with integer floor division. Graduated tiers price each unit in the tier it falls into, not all units at one rate.
